title: How to Alleviate Correlation Neglect in Investment Decisions
authors: Christine Laudenbach; Michael Ungeheuer; Martin Weber
eligible_reason: Lab and online investment experiments (z-Tree/oTree). Subjects allocate between two assets over rounds; the correlation sign (pos_correlation) varies within subject and the presentation format (sampling vs description) is randomized between subjects. Main regressions are xtreg share_2 pos_correlation_sampling sampling pos_correlation, re (random effects; FE versions with vce(cluster subject)). This is an interaction of two randomized manipulations, not a staggered-adoption DiD; no calendar-time adoption and random-effects intercepts in the headline columns.
design_notes: Stata xtreg re/fe on subject x round data for Experiments 1-4. Robustness: first-round OLS, learning terms, order effects (lastcorrpos, firstcorrpos), realized correlation.
data_files_note: Experimental data for all four experiments shipped with variable dictionary.
screener_notes: Screened from package and OpenAlex abstract. Randomized lab experiment; not a DiD design.
